elements.errPendCancel: We're still working on your original cancellation request. If you don't get a confirmation email within three business days, call us at 800.531.5000.
elements.txtConditions:
• It can take up to three business days to process your request. Your cancellation won't be final until we send you a confirmation email.
  • If we can't complete your request, we'll contact you at the email above. If this isn't your current email, please update your profile today.
  • Some customers will need to return their receivers to avoid fees. We'll email you if this applies to you.
  • Satellite dishes don't need to be returned.
  • Your special offers, discounts and promotional credits will be canceled, and DVR recordings will be deleted.
  • If you have an active contract or don’t return your equipment within 21 days of canceling, your final bill may include an early termination fee or equipment non-return fee.
